title: F-Zero GX
shortDescription: Sega Amusement Vision's blistering 60fps futuristic racer featuring 30 pilots competing at over 1,000 km/h.
historicalSignificance: Revered among racing purists as the most mechanically demanding and visually spectacular futuristic racer ever made.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
